Floating Lyrics is a companion to your music app, not a music player. With matching timed lyrics, the highlighted line follows the playback position your music app shares.

Line-by-line synchronization. Not word-by-word karaoke.

Made for your collection

Bring your own words.

Have synchronized LRC files? Bring them along. Match your lyrics to the recording you love, then keep reading while your music app handles the sound.

Read the setup guide
01
Connect to your music.

Notification access lets Floating Lyrics read the music app’s track information and playback position.

02
Make room for the words.

Display-over-other-apps permission lets the lyrics window stay visible when you switch apps.

03

Use lyrics timed for your recording. Availability and music-app compatibility vary by track and device.
